title: Crab holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M52 38 Q48 48 50 56' fill='none' stroke='#e8e8ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='24' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='24' rx='12' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='19' rx='3.5' ry='5' fill='#ffb3c1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- balloon knot -->
  <path d='M52 38 L54 41 L56 38 Z' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <!-- crab body -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='68' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='68' rx='20' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#ffb86b' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- crab shell highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='63' rx='10' ry='5' fill='#ffbf80' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='58' r='5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='58' r='5' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#5a3300'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#5a3300'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='57' r='1' fill='#fff5cc'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='57' r='1' fill='#fff5cc'/>
  <!-- eye stalks -->
  <rect x='35' y='52' width='4' height='7' rx='2' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <rect x='51' y='52' width='4' height='7' rx='2' fill='#ff9a3c'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M39 72 Q45 77 51 72' fill='none' stroke='#b35900' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left claw holding string -->
  <path d='M28 62 Q20 58 18 52 Q16 46 22 44 Q26 43 28 48' fill='#ff9a3c' stroke='#ffb86b' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- claw pincer gap -->
  <path d='M22 44 L26 50' fill='none' stroke='#d97706' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right claw -->
  <path d='M62 62 Q70 56 72 62 Q74 68 68 70 Q64 71 62 66' fill='#ff9a3c' stroke='#ffb86b' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 62 L66 64' fill='none' stroke='#d97706' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <path d='M30 78 Q24 84 20 82' fill='none' stroke='#ff9a3c' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M36 81 Q32 88 28 87' fill='none' stroke='#ff9a3c' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 81 Q58 88 62 87' fill='none' stroke='#ff9a3c' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 78 Q66 84 70 82' fill='none' stroke='#ff9a3c' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sand shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='88' rx='24' ry='3' fill='#4a3b78' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
